articles.title: Hurricane Nolo Is Crawling Toward Hawaii — And It's Carrying a Lot of Rain
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is creeping toward Hawaii at just 5 mph. It might not hit land, but it could dump up to 2 feet of rain on the Big Island, and people there are getting ready now.

articles.title: Supreme Court Says Missouri Will Use Its Old Voting Map — For Now
articles.summary: The Supreme Court just said Missouri can't use a new voting map for the November election. That means voters will use the same districts as 2022 and 2024 — and absentee voting has already started.

articles.title: Iran Says It Can Reopen a Key Oil Waterway in Just 7 Days
articles.summary: Iran says it has a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz — a narrow sea passage where about 18 ships pass each day — within a week. But the US has to agree first, and talks have fallen apart before.
